screenshots.publication: Local only; no images or owner backups uploaded to GitHub.

contracts: Store selection upgrade preserves legacy favourites, reminders and other documents
Store destinations use explicit gestures, fixed HTTPS URLs, noopener and noreferrer; no automatic merchant request or cart transfer
Reviewed list text excludes notes, prices, budget, identifiers and other lists
Cancellation, failure, pending sharing, empty lists and subsequent data changes preserve the reviewed copy and saved documents
TXT downloads match the preview exactly and follow an explicit button press
Device and manual language, EUR amounts, menu confirmation/cancellation, allowlisted privacy downloads and fail-closed missing Web Locks pass
limitations: Linux WebKit automation is not physical iPhone, Safari iOS, VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, native keyboard or safe-area acceptance.
Web Share and external window opening are mocked browser contracts; no real recipient, retailer session, price feed, order or payment is tested.
The earlier 92-case run used a superseded bundle before Chromium found and the app fixed opener focus restoration; it is retained as diagnosis, not final acceptance.
